From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@novalytics.com>
Date: 2026-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick 30-minute demo after AI Summit registration

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood’s AI Summit session earlier this week. I’m Ben on the outreach team — great to see Novalytics on the attendee list. Would you be open to a short, 30-minute tailored demo to walk through how Redwood can help reduce inference costs and simplify rollout for your internal models?

A quick agenda I usually run through:
- 10 min: context & priorities (your topology and latency targets)
- 15 min: live demo (serving runtime + routing examples)
- 5 min: next steps (pricing/POC options)

If that works, I can send a few time options or you can pick straight from my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo (feel free to forward to anyone else on your team).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment: MA_Summit_Attendee_Deck.pdf (1.2 MB)

Date: 2026-04-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick 30-minute demo after AI Summit registration

Hi Ben —

Thanks for reaching out and for the deck — appreciate it. We recently started evaluating inference costs across several teams; a short demo sounds useful. My availability next week (PST):
- Tue 5/5, 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 5/6, 09:00–10:00

If possible, I’d love the demo to touch on private deployment options and how Redwood handles KV cache and multi-tenant routing. CC’ing Maria (who owns infra at Novalytics) would be helpful — I’ll loop her in if that works.

Best,
Alex
Head of ML Ops, Novalytics
